  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast bias when recent history shows strong upward momentum (e.g., >65.00) and model fails to capture mean reversion.",
    "Increase forecast lag correction for periods with low volatility or flat history (e.g., <60.00 for 5+ days).",
    "Apply upward bias correction after sharp price spikes (e.g., >70.00) to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment>0.00), increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices, but cap at +10% above prior peak.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), apply smoothing to reduce overfitting to short-term noise.",
    "If model consistently underestimates true outcomes in early periods (e.g., first 5 days of history), apply a +5% bias correction."
  ]
}
